Name: MSC Interpreter function
Notes:
r0 - MSC command offset (from r12)
r6 - MSC file location
r10 - command w/o bits set
r12 - MSC file location + 0x30
r19 - command w/ bits set
r21 - MSC file location + 0x34
r25 - MSC file location + 0x33
r26 - MSC file location + 0x32
r27 - MSC file location + 0x31
r28 - Global var array offset
r29 - Local var array offset
r30 - MSC comand offset (from r12)
r31 - MSC stack, 0x200(r31) - stack index
